recent: the main square of her element's kingdom — standing

a compact sleeper-train cabin at dawn, a padded lower berth, a soft window curtain and quiet fields outside — she leans forward to catch a pear rolling across the berth; the crouch expands the accordion side pleats of her sleep outfit and exposes its securely opaque high-waisted short underlayer at the hip
the sheltered balcony of an old white lighthouse on a calm morning, pale sea and gulls far below — she listens to the sea inside a large empty shell and smiles at how loud the small shell sounds
an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground
a steelworks floor beside a glowing blast furnace — holds a palm-sized rainbow-iridescent bismuth hopper crystal at chest height
a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — sitting on the ground
her own room in a house of her element's kingdom — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height
a neon-lit bar counter with backlit bottles — brings a cocktail glass to her lips
a retro American diner — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie
a garden with a pond in her element's kingdom — holds a brass compass flat in her palm at chest height
a wide salt pan at low tide — standing
the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — carries a small heavy stoppered glass vial of red-brown liquid breathing an orange-red wisp low at her side
a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
